summary.outcome: Elsewhere is implemented, deployed through the existing GitHub-connected Cloudflare Worker, and usable at the assigned HTTPS URL. 39 Worker integration tests, 8 local and 8 production desktop/mobile browser cases, 22 live production smoke checks and 16 authenticated admin browser checks passed. Transactional verification/reset sends were accepted without recorded email failures; actual inbox receipt and production link consumption remain unverified. Deployment fields identify the last observed verified build at report generation. Static HTML header protection is being repaired and will be verified before final handoff.
